mit-1-2-example-composition: For \(g(t)=2t+1\) and \(f(t)=4t\), composition gives \(f(g(t))=8t+4\). The resulting slope is the product of the two slopes.
mit-1-2-example-two-speed: Starting with \(f(0)=0\), a velocity of \(2\) up to \(t=5\) gives \(f(5)=10\). A velocity of \(3\) thereafter gives \(f(t)=10+3(t-5)\), with continuity at the change.
mit-1-3-example-square: For \(f(t)=t^2\), the average velocity over an increment \(h\) is \(2t+h\). As \(h\to0\), the instantaneous velocity is \(v(t)=2t\).
